answer_1.quote: automatic rap lyrics generation has drawn attention from academia ... we develop DeepRapper, a Transformer based rap generation system which can model both rhymes and rhythms.

answer_2.quote: We choose five metrics to evaluate our model: 1) Perplexity (PPL), ... 2) Rhyme Accuracy (RA), ... 3) Rhyme Density (RD), ... 4) Combo-N, ... 5) Beat Accuracy (BA)

answer_4.quote: in artistic creation, we also use human evaluation to accurately evaluate the quality of the generated raps. We invite 10 participants with professional knowledge in music as human annotators to evaluate 100 sampled raps.
answer_4.guideline: Each annotator is required to score from 1 (Poor) to 5 (Perfect) on the following perspectives: 1) the clearness of the theme of the rap lyrics; 2) the fluency of the rap lyrics; 3) the quality of the rhyme; 4) the diversity of the rhyme.
